## Summary

Compare species and functional turnover to see if different between coast and oceans

* Species and functional richness, current and projected change
* Bathymetry to determine coastal vs shallow



## Data

* GEBCO gridded elevation - GEBCO_2026 Grid (sub-ice topo/bathy): https://www.gebco.net/data-products/gridded-bathymetry-data#global
    * download link: https://dap.ceda.ac.uk/bodc/gebco/global/gebco_2026/sub_ice_topography_bathymetry/netcdf/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice.zip?download=1
    * Stored in `_data/gebco_2026/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice_0.05.nc`
        * This is an aggregated NetCDF from 15 arc-second to 0.05 degree; the original 7 GB NetCDF is aggregated then deleted.

## Methods

Load turnover maps, partition out by neritic/coastal (<= 200m) and oceanic (>200m) using GEBCO bathymetry.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(collapse)
library(cowplot)
```

### Read in and rasterize turnover metrics

These rasters were created in scripts 1 (spp turnover) and 2 (fe turnover) in the Behrmann projection.

```{r read rasts}

spp_turn_r  <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_turnover.tif'))
fe_turn_r   <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_turnover.tif'))

nspp_r <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_richness.tif'))
nfe_r  <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_richness.tif'))
```

### Read in and transform GEBCO bathymetry

```{r}
bathy_r_4326 <- rast(here('_data/gebco_2026/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice_0.05.nc'))
bathy_r_4326[bathy_r_4326 >= -200] <- 1 ### 1 is coastal
bathy_r_4326[bathy_r_4326 < -200]  <- 2 ### 2 is oceanic

bathy_r <- project(bathy_r_4326, spp_turn_r[[1]]) |> 
  round() |> ### 
  mask(spp_turn_r[[1]])
```

### Compare oceanic and coastal turnover (full ocean)

This compares stats across the whole ocean (vs. the MEOW comparisons which exclude much of the ABNJ)

TO DO: drop slice_sample; finish stats for MEOW version; compare ocean/coastal per marine realm and province (as on the plot) to verify low P value

```{r}
combined_r <- c(spp_turn_r[[1]], fe_turn_r[[1]], bathy_r)
combined_df <- as.data.frame(combined_r, xy = TRUE) |> 
  setNames(c('x', 'y', 'spp', 'fe', 'depth'))

long_df <- combined_df |> 
  slice_sample(n = 1e6, by = depth) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(spp, fe),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "turnover"
  )

stats_df <- long_df |> 
  group_by(variable, depth) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(turnover, na.rm = TRUE))

summary_df <- long_df |> 
  group_by(variable) |> 
  summarise(
    test = list(t.test(turnover ~ depth)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(tidy_result = map(test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy_result)

stats_df

summary_df |> select(-test, -parameter, -method)
```


### Compare oceanic and coastal turnover (MEOW)

This compares stats between coastal and ocean, restricted to the MEOW regions.

```{r}
meow_r <- rast(here('_data/mregions_2026/meow_eco_code.tif'))
meow_combined_r <- c(spp_turn_r[[1]], fe_turn_r[[1]], bathy_r, meow_r)
meow_combined_df <- as.data.frame(meow_combined_r, xy = TRUE) |> 
  setNames(c('x', 'y', 'spp', 'fe', 'depth', 'meow'))
meow_lookup <- read_csv(here('_data/mregions_2026/meow_lookup_complete.csv'))

meow_long_df <- meow_combined_df |> 
  filter(!is.na(meow)) |> 
  slice_sample(n = 1e6, by = depth) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(spp, fe),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "turnover"
  ) |> 
  left_join(meow_lookup, by = c('meow' = 'eco_code'))

meow_stats1_df <- meow_long_df |> 
  group_by(variable, depth, realm) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(turnover, na.rm = TRUE))
meow_stats2_df <- meow_long_df |> 
  group_by(variable, depth, province) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(turnover, na.rm = TRUE))

meow_summary1_df <- meow_long_df |> 
  group_by(variable, realm) |> 
  summarise(
    test = list(t.test(turnover ~ depth)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(tidy_result = map(test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy_result)
meow_summary2_df <- meow_long_df |> 
  group_by(variable, province) |> 
  summarise(
    test = list(t.test(turnover ~ depth)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(tidy_result = map(test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy_result)

meow_stats1_df
meow_stats2_df

meow_summary1_df |> select(-test, -parameter, -method) |> DT::datatable()
meow_summary2_df |> select(-test, -parameter, -method) |> DT::datatable()
```
